title: Product Management — Every Tab of the Product Profile
purpose: After you create a product, its profile holds everything about it. This guide explains each tab in the profile's left menu and the import option on the product list.
meta: Document · Shipping Detail · Compliance Data · Quality Requirement · AI Risk Screening · CPSC eFiling · Packaging Detail · QR Code
Create and edit a product: [[guide:product-management|Product Management — Create and Edit a Product]]

QMAS dev, 4 Nov 2026. Document, Shipping Detail, the empty Compliance Data tab, the in-progress Test Data form, the empty Certificate Data form, and the Quality Requirement shots included here were rechecked on QMAS dev, 9 Nov 2026.
overview: **Document**: upload, organise, share and set reminders for the product's files.
**Shipping Detail**: sizes, weights and barcodes for the selling unit and cartons.
**Compliance Data**: record test results, certificates and other compliance data.
**Quality Requirement**: list the product's quality requirements, use templates and send them to testing or document review.
**AI Risk Screening**: run AI compliance screenings for this product.
**CPSC eFiling**: submit eFiling for this product and see its eFiling log.
**Packaging Detail**: record each packaging component, its materials and suppliers.
**QR Code** is also in the left menu. This guide does not yet describe that screen.

body: Shows every file linked to the product. Use **New Folder** to organise files and **Upload** to add a file (see the Document Management guide for the upload pop-up). Filter by **Type**, **Source** or **Checked**, switch between **All** and **Archived**, and search with **Search Files**. **Sort** and **Reset** sit with those filters.

body: **Test Data** records one test result:

list: **Result** (required): Passed, Failed or Report As Is.
**Export Market** (required). For US eFiling, choose **United States (CPSC eFiling submission)**.

**Legislation, Test Item & Citation** (required): type in this field. The reviewed screenshot sets Export Market to Africa and shows **+ Add '[UAT TEST]'**. It is not a legislation results list and not a saved Test Data record.
**Report ID**, **Issue Party** (required), **Expiry Date** and **Test Date / Report Date**.
Link the report under **Existing Product Document** (a file already on the product) or **New Document**.

body: Quality Requirement lists what the product must meet, for example test standards or packaging rules. Each requirement has a **Type** (the group) and a **Name**. You can attach compliance data to it as proof, mark it completed, and reuse the list in Product Testing or Document Review.
The reviewed screenshot is not an empty tab. It shows one requirement with the name hidden, plus Test Plan, ⋯ and Add. The attachment area under that row is empty.

body: **4a. Add a requirement yourself**

list: Click **Add Requirement** (or **Add** at the top right once the list has items).
**Type**: pick an existing type, or type a new one and choose **+ Create “…”**.
**Name**: pick a name from the list for that type. Picking a different Type clears the Name.
Tick **Mandatory** if the requirement must be met, then click **Confirm**.

body.caption: Add Requirement modal — Type and Name empty, Mandatory checked (not a filled Type and Name example).
body.alt: Add Requirement modal with empty Type and Name fields and Mandatory checked.

body: **4b. Add requirements from a template (fastest)**
Click **⋯** next to the title → **Templates**:

table: Pick a saved template (use **View** to preview it) and click **Apply**. All its requirements are added.
Save this product's requirements as a template for other products.
See and manage your saved templates.

body: **4c. Attach proof and complete a requirement**

list: Click **+** on a requirement to open **Attach Compliance Data**. Choose the **Test Data**, **Certificate Data** or **Other** tab, tick the records and click **Confirm**. If a record you just added is missing, click **Reload Data**. To add new data, go to Compliance Data first.
Click **⌄** to expand a requirement and see the attached data. Click the bin icon to detach it.
Click **⋯** on a requirement for **Edit**, **Duplicate**, **Upload Document**, **Mark As Completed** and **Remove**.
**Mark As Completed** shows “Requirement Completed” and turns the requirement’s tick green.

body.caption: Attach Compliance Data — tick the test record.
The attached test data under the requirement.
⋯ menu on one requirement.
Requirement marked as completed.

body: **4d. Send requirements to a job**

list: **⋯ → Import To Product Testing**: tick the requirements (or **Select All**) and click **Confirm to Create Job**. Product Testing → Request Quotations opens with this product added, and the requirements appear under **Quality Requirement** in step 2.
**⋯ → Import to Document Review** → **Create Job** or **Create Job for supplier**: opens the matching Document Review form for this product.
**⋯ → Export As Document**: exports the requirement list as a document.

body.caption: Import To Product Testing — choose requirements, then Confirm to Create Job.
The requirement carried into Product Testing step 2.
Import to Document Review → Create Job or Create Job for supplier.

body: **4e. Test Plan (AI)**

Click **Test Plan** to let AI suggest a test plan. Fill in the **Product Description** (more detail gives better results), **Import Country** and **Product Intended Used By**, upload up to 6 product images, then click **Generate Test Plan**.

body.caption: Test Plan pop-up.

body: Lists the AI screenings for this product. Click **Add** to start one. The pop-up and results are explained in the [[guide:ai-insight|AI Insight]] guide.

body.caption: AI Risk Screening tab.

body: Shows the **eFiling Log** for this product. Click **Submit eFiling** to create an eFiling. Before you can sync with CPSC, add your API Key and Secret Key in **Company Profile** (link in the grey note). The full flow is in the [[guide:efiling|eFiling]] guide.

body.caption: CPSC eFiling tab.

body: Lists the packaging components of the product. Click **Create Packaging Component** and fill in:

list: **Basic Information**: name and description (required), identification no., function, legal role, weight, material type and name, status (Active, Inactive or Draft), and packaging images.
**Dimension**, **Additional Information**, **Supplier Linkage** and **Technical Documentation** (expand each section).

body: Click **Confirm**. Use the **Status** filter to show active, inactive or draft components.

body.caption: Packaging Details tab.
Create Packaging Component.

body: On the Product Management list, click **Import Product**. Download the ICW Product template (**download here**), fill it in, upload the Excel file (one file at a time), then click **Next**. Only the ICW template can be used.

tips: **Hide product details** at the top right hides the product card on the left.
Link test reports to Test Data. eFiling can reuse this data when you quick-select test data.
Use requirement **Templates** so similar products get the same requirements.
faq: How do I add a test result to a product?
Open the product → Compliance Data → Test Data → Add Data. Fill in Result, Export Market, Legislation/Test Item, Issue Party, link the report, then Confirm.
How do I share a product document?
Open the product → Document, tick the file, click Share, choose the link expiry, then Copy or By Email.
How do I add quality requirements to a product?
Open the product → Quality Requirement → Add Requirement, or ⋯ → Templates to apply a saved template.
Where do I record packaging information?
Open the product → Packaging Detail → Create Packaging Component.
How do I import many products?
On Product Management, click Import Product, download the ICW template, fill it in and upload it.
How do I reuse quality requirements for many products?
Open a product → Quality Requirement → ⋯ → Templates → Save As Template. On other products use ⋯ → Templates → Apply Template.
How do I prove a requirement is met?
On the requirement click +, attach the test or certificate data, then ⋯ → Mark As Completed.
